high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "dailymcstuff." The post features two side-by-side photographs of a monkey in what appears to be a zoo enclosure. In the left photo, the monkey is seen sharpening a rock on a flat surface, possibly a concrete floor or a similar hard surface within the enclosure. In the right photo, the monkey is using the sharpened rock to shatter a glass pane of its enclosure. Below the images, there is a caption that reads: "Zoo's Visitor Sees Monkey Sharpening A Rock, Later It Uses It To Shatter Its Glass Enc
